title: "Node accents up" is inert: router_led is never drawn — puck sprites still bake the old muted LED green
detail: Spec item 3 ("node accents up — router LEDs, tier rings") produces zero pixel change: sprites.ok is the shipped path, so the token change never renders, and the palette token now contradicts gen_sprites.py's canon LED hex.
recommended_fix: Either regenerate the puck sprites from the new LED hex (then re-bless) or revert the token and document the deferral; at minimum sync gen_sprites.py ROUTER_LED with palette.json router_led.

title: CVD mode tables still remap pipes/lanes to muted-era colors — the pop is suppressed for colorblind modes it no longer needs to be
evidence:
data/palette.json modes (all three tables), e.g. deutan:
      "lane_standard":   [130, 136, 160, 255],
      "lane_best_effort": [88, 98, 54, 255],
      "pipe_copper":     [188, 108, 40, 255],
      "pipe_steel":      [122, 132, 146, 255],
      "pipe_fiber":      [36, 60, 132, 255],
(122,132,146 ≈ the OLD muted steel base 126,134,146.) tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py docstring: "1. Take the canon palette tokens (data/palette.json)... 5. Emit the JSON mode tables... paste the 'modes' block into data/palette.json verbatim." I re-simulated the NEW base with no overrides (repo's Machado severity-1.0 matrices, palcheck's 48 threshold): deutan and protan — every signal pair separates (stale pipe overrides unnecessary); tritan — only lane_standard↔lane_best_effort collides (28.7).
detail: The tables were derived from the pre-change muted palette and were not re-derived; deutan/protan players get none of the vivid network despite it separating fine, and palette.json's provenance claim ("simulator-derived by tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py") is now false for 5 tokens.
recommended_fix: Re-run tools/derive_a11y_palettes.py against the new base (expect pipe overrides to drop for deutan/protan; a lane-only tritan remap), verify with palcheck, re-bless a11y goldens.

title: saturation-evidence.md token table misstates HSL values; "all sat ≥ 0.73" and "dense frames all cross 0.85" contradict its own data
evidence:
Lines 26-28:
| lane_standard | #6C7A8E | #3882C8 steel-blue | 0.73 | 212 |
| lane_best_effort | #58986C | #30B260 green | 0.74 | 140 |
| router_led | #2E8B57 | #00CD5A vivid LED green | 0.76 | 145 |
Line 99:
- Network tokens all sat ≥ 0.73; band-area warm-gold share 74% ≈ the
Line 52: | growth-88000ms (late dense) | 0.687 | 0.826 | +0.139 |
Lines 74-75:
token-only scope. The dense frames — the ones a thumbnail actually shows —
all cross 0.85.
Computed with the doc's own method (PIL colorsys.rgb_to_hls): #3882C8 sat=0.567 hue=209.2; #30B260 sat=0.575 hue=142.2; #00CD5A sat=1.000. (Frame-level ceilings DO reproduce exactly: 0.886/0.879/0.913/0.826/0.715/0.698.)
detail: The lane tokens are 0.567/0.575 HSL, not ≥0.73, so the 70/30 verification line is arithmetically wrong; and growth-88000 (0.826), labeled "late dense", contradicts "the dense frames... all cross 0.85".
recommended_fix: Correct the table to the measured HSL values (or state the actual metric per row) and reword the 0.85 prose to name which frames cross it.
